lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured matrix of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in at least five identifiable vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with three to five clusters per column visible on the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical linear features of higher luminance intersect with the circular clusters; clusters are centered within these bands, forming a repeating grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient (bright superiorly, dark inferiorly) extending longitudinally across the upper and mid-lateral flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible lateral surface of the first dorsal fin contains approximately seven to nine high-luminance spots of irregular size distributed across the macro-mask silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct semi-circular notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A group of high-chroma yellow pixel clusters (commensal fish) is located in the water column immediately below the ventral surface of the left pectoral fin.
